restrictions: Hash 36-byte messages with the fixed SHA-256 IV, FIPS padding, indices 0 through 30 on the single padded block, full feed-forward, and the full 256-bit digest.
Draw n = 2^128 independent uniform messages, two fresh 256-bit words each. One batch, no restarts, no deterministic seed expansion.
Detect collisions with the two-level Briggs-Torczon dictionary in the proof. Charge both control-flow arms, at most 80 ordinary word operations per sample plus one compression.
Return only after recomputing both digests. Repeated messages are not collisions. No differential, stored pair, or undeclared heuristic is used.
baseline_improved names the nominal display reference sha256-r31-nominal-v2. It is not an established attack or a qualified baseline. data_log2 is omitted.
